learning_objective: 🎯 Let us learn how to share things equally with friends and measure the world around us!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When we divide sweets equally among friends so everyone gets the exact same amount, it is called division!
We use a ruler or a measuring tape to find out how long or tall things are. We measure small things in centimeters and big things in meters.
When we buy fresh fruits, the shopkeeper uses a weighing scale to check how heavy they are using grams and kilograms.

fun_activity.title: ⚖️ Home Shopkeeper
fun_activity.instructions: Gather 12 small buttons or beans. Pretend to be a shopkeeper and share them equally into 3 small cups. How many go in each cup?

quick_recap: ⭐ Division means sharing things equally so no one feels left out.
⭐ We use rulers and tapes to measure the length of objects.
⭐ Grams and kilograms help us understand how light or heavy something is.
